Type: chair
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Vibe Swivel Leather Office Chair, 25.2"W, Medium Brown
Colors: Brown Leather
Materials: Leather; Matel base
While designed for the office, this swivel chair adds refreshing style to any room. The Mid-century inspired square silhouette features top grain leather upholstery on low-profile back and arms. Four metal legs extend outward from the swivel base. 25.2"W x 24.8" x29.5"H Top grain leather upholstery; black metal swivel base and legs Suitable for any room, the leather upholstery shows natural markings No assembly required. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
